title: Payments system
prompt: Design a payments system that lets merchants charge their customers' cards and issue refunds.
key_points: Required idempotency keys, enforced by a unique constraint, and passed our payment ID to the provider as its idempotency key
Used a double-entry ledger with integer minor units, never floats
Modeled an explicit payment state machine with conditional-update transitions, never deleting
Handled the unknown outcome of a timeout: stay pending, retry with the same key or query status, never assume failure
Reconciled against processor settlement files, with mismatches becoming tickets
Kept PCI scope small with tokenization; published events through an outbox and signed, retried webhooks
